name: javis-access-broker
description: Javis's access broker. For one ask_javis request from an outside agent it questions the agent when the task is missing or unclear, looks only at the per-request slice javis-server prepared, and submits the minimum answer the task needs, every point citing a slice id. Delivered by tag (javis-access-broker-v<version>) to javis-server, which sends the SKILL.md body as the instructions of the locked-down access-broker openclaw agent. Not a store skill and never installed into the user's workspace.
